account_population.authority: all syntactically valid unique local /etc/passwd rows with an absolute home path
account_population.binary_safety: NUL or CR in /etc/passwd or local sensitive-file inventory => ERROR before Bash line parsing.
account_population.home_state: Absent home is outside file-mode population; existing home must be readable/searchable real directory; symlink/non-directory => ERROR; physical homes deduplicated.
account_population.nss_scope: Local /etc/passwd is v2 authority; NSS/network-only identities remain outside this local-file source observer.
account_population.selector: No UID_MIN or login-shell exclusion. Service/system accounts are included because source says users without interactive-only qualification.

donor_disposition.adapt: All local passwd user homes are evaluated; source examples are supplemented by independent filename-class discovery and mandatory local augmentation inventory.
donor_disposition.reject: Interactive-only UID_MIN/shell filtering and inventory-only completeness are rejected after retrospective counterexamples.
donor_disposition.reuse: Donor exact chmod go-rwx relation (mode & 0077 == 0) and the eight explicit source-example names.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs exercised the selected account heuristic and direct source-example discovery. Evidence supports implementation assumptions; it does not turn observed host modes into normative policy and does not extend SUPPORTED target beyond ubuntu-24.04-x86_64.

non_requirements.file_contents: No sensitive file contents are read or emitted.
non_requirements.home_mode: Home directory mode 0700 belongs to SRC-0015 and is not added to SRC-0014.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is evidence only and is not added to SRC-0014.

permissions_control.comparison: For each present regular inventory member, mode & 0077 == 0; this is the exact chmod go-rwx relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more present sensitive files have any group/other rwx bit.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated and violations=0.

sensitive_file_population.authority_role: Required augmentation for locally applicable unusual, custom-XDG, or shell-overridden shell/history/R-subsystem paths; it is no longer the sole completeness claim.
sensitive_file_population.dynamic_discovery: Each existing local user home is recursively scanned xdev. Independent discovery uses an explicit common-shell artifact set instead of broad suffix matching: Bash .bash_login; zsh/ksh/csh/tcsh history/login/config basenames; fish *.fish plus fish_history; Nushell Linux-default config/login/autoload/history paths; Xonsh Linux-default rc.xsh/rc.d and JSON/SQLite history paths; and Elvish Linux-default plus legacy rc/history database paths. Broad patterns such as *rc/*env are forbidden because they capture unrelated application files such as .vimrc. Required local inventory remains the augmentation channel for custom XDG locations, shell-specific overrides, and other unusual applicable shell/history paths.
sensitive_file_population.missing_authority: Missing/symlink/unreadable/malformed inventory => ERROR because unusual locally applicable names still require an explicit augmentation channel.
sensitive_file_population.symlink_policy: Any dynamically selected/inventory-selected symlink or nonregular object => ERROR; regular targets are not followed outside the home.
sensitive_file_population.traversal: find/sort/stat ambiguity => ERROR; partial PASS prohibited.
